understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid to complete every goal cell in each level. A goal cell can only be completed by stepping onto it when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes; completing all goals advances to the next level, and winning requires finishing all levels before running out of lives/turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (N/S/E/W) costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose a life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, and the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen because the move won’t change position and still wastes stamina. Certain tiles modify the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shapes 0–5, color tiles cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise through 0°→90°→180°→270°→0°. Goals only activate when shape+color+rotation all match; then stepping onto that goal completes it. Planning efficient routes to needed modifier tiles (and optionally stamina refills if present) is essential to avoid wasted moves and life loss.
